i'm getting more cautious on risk assets as the momentum in equities starts to weaken

stocks have had an incredible run since late 2022, with AI leading much of the upside, but we're starting to see signs of slowing momentum and pressure on some of the largest companies

if equities enter a broader correction, i expect crypto to face significant selling pressure as investors reduce risk across their portfolios

there's an argument that Bitcoin could hold up better as an inflation hedge, but historically, investors have still sold BTC during periods of broader market stress

i think the direction of equities is one of the most important things to watch for crypto rn

Made the decision yesterday to return to my roots on fomo and focus 100% on $HMM.

The first time I was on top of the leaderboard, HMM was my only position.

I strayed a bit and traded in and out of other positions with the goal of “stacking more” and ultimately finally realized the best way to stack more of something you believe in more than anything else… is to just stack it rather than anything else.

Doesn’t mean I don’t believe some of the other names and projects I’ve talked about or others have on Robinhood won’t ultimate do well, I just believe HMM will do better.

The power of concentrated capital and attention is something you don’t see very often these days, but I believe it works.

I’ll keep stacking more as long as we’re under ATHs and honestly won’t look at adding anything else into the port again until Thinking Cat is well above ATHs.

It’s time to teach people how to believe in something again.

Billions will think 🤔🐈
